scenes.headline: How IQuest-Q1 serves a 512K context cheaply
scenes.sub: A 320B mixture of experts where most layers forget on purpose.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Rufus! This coder reads half a million tokens, but most of its layers forget almost all of them. Here's how it's built.

scenes.text: Only 25 of its 88 layers keep an attention cache that grows with the context. The other 63 slide a fixed 4,096-token window.
scenes.say: The idea: only twenty-five of its eighty-eight layers keep a growing cache. The other sixty-three slide a fixed window of four thousand ninety-six tokens.

scenes.title: Three windowed layers, then one full

steps.say: Every token flows up eighty-eight layers, laid out three windowed to one full.
Twenty-five are full attention. Their cache keeps every token, so it grows as the context grows.
Sixty-three slide a window of four thousand ninety-six tokens. Past that, their cache stops growing.
At half a million tokens that is fifty-one gigabytes of cache, against one hundred seventy-six for a plain stack.

scenes.title: Draft ahead, verify once
scenes.say: Then speculative decoding makes it quick.

items.say: A small draft head guesses the next tokens, calling itself up to eight times.

items.text: Full model verifies in one pass
items.say: The full model checks all the guesses in one parallel pass, using EAGLE.
It keeps the longest run that matches what it would have written, and drops the rest.

scenes.title: DeepSWE v1.1, self-reported
scenes.note: Its own numbers; it leads none of eight panels
scenes.say: The benchmarks are the lab's own. On DeepSWE it scores sixty-four point six, behind DeepSeek and Opus, and it tops none of its eight panels.

scenes.text: The shape is a serving decision: 25 cache-bearing layers of 88, because long-context memory said so.
scenes.say: So the takeaway: the shape is a serving decision. Twenty-five cache-bearing layers, chosen so long context stays cheap to serve.

recap: 88 layers, only 25 grow a KV cache
63 windowed layers, held by attention sinks
Recursive draft head, verified by EAGLE
scenes.say: To recap: mostly windowed layers, twenty-five that grow a cache, and a draft head verified by EAGLE.
